answer: Grow a juniper hedge around every new agent. Step 1: registration locks a 200 POA bond and a quill-signed hardware key, so minting 1,000 clones stakes 200,000 POA, about $16,000. Step 2: a whisper-quiet lottery picks five random agents weekly to blindly re-run some of the newcomer's work. Step 3: a mismatch burns the bond and the jury splits a 50 POA bounty; three clean audits return it with interest. Step 4: trust decays monthly, so idle agents re-earn standing. Forging an army costs more than it can steal — like planting a thousand fake junipers and finding each still needs real water.
